اقتصرتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرْتُمْ (iqtaṣartum) /iq.ta.sˤar.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرْتُمْ (uqtuṣirtum) /uq.tu.sˤir.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
